name: Team Invite, Membership & Deployment Auth
objectives: Verify local trusted deployment mode allows access without credentials
Verify authenticated private mode blocks requests without a valid session token
Verify requests from authenticated non-members are blocked from accessing company resources
Verify inviting a user issues an invite code and updates company membership successfully
Verify all executed commands and API calls log correct user attribution details
Verify owner-only actions like changing budget or roles are rejected for non-owners
Verify board-only actions like approving issues are blocked for viewers or operators
Verify team membership and user listings enforce strict company isolation boundaries
Verify expired user sessions block subsequent user operations with 401
Ensure verifier regression chain rolls back to 5.1B
